notes.title: Cyber-Doge 2077 Announcement
notes.notes:
h3]Hello friends![/h3]
[h3]We have a new game coming out soon - Cyber-Doge 2077: Meme runner.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=wyzZi_0rXMk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]About the game[/h1]
Furious 3D runner about a pumped up dog. Run as far as possible! Collect coins! Set new records and enjoy a great soundtrack.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383720/Cyberdoge_2077_Meme_runner/

[h2]If you like the game, please [u]add it to your Steam Wishlist.[/u][/h2]

Best regards,
Take Toad.

notes.title: Let's talk!
notes.notes: Super Cucho is my first game. The game is "handmade" - as I call it. I would like to discuss it with someone from the side. I am still very inexperienced and tend to make many mistakes. Your opinion will help me a lot to develop both this game and the subsequent ones. Thank.
